step1.description:
In this episode, creator of solidjs Ryan Carniato walks us through what soldjs is? what team has been working on and what to expect in next major release

https://twitter.com/solid_js
https://twitter.com/RyanCarniato
https://www.solidjs.com/

Chapter 1: Introduction (00:00 - 03:20)

Introduction to the show and the guests
Brief overview of SolidJS
Chapter 2: The History of SolidJS (03:20 - 12:00)

Ryan's background and motivation for creating SolidJS
The challenges of promoting SolidJS in the early days
The influence of other JavaScript frameworks on SolidJS
Chapter 3: The Core Principles of SolidJS (12:00 - 20:00)

The concept of "primitives" in SolidJS
The benefits of using primitives in web development
How SolidJS's reactivity model differs from other frameworks
Chapter 4: Solid Start: A Meta Framework for SolidJS (20:00 - 30:00)

The purpose of Solid Start
How Solid Start simplifies the development process with SolidJS
The modular design of Solid Start
Chapter 5: The Future of SolidJS (30:00 - 40:00)

Ryan's vision for the future of SolidJS
The focus on primitives and interoperability
The goal of making SolidJS accessible to a wider audience
Chapter 6: Q&A (40:00 - 50:00)

Questions from the hosts and viewers
Discussion of Angular and NX integrations
The possibility of SQL Lite support on edge workers
Netlify's focus on data pipelines
Chapter 7: Outro (50:00 - 50:30)

Closing remarks and thanks to the guests
